capabilities: Render OpenAPI/Swagger specs as knife4j-style documentation with tag trees, method badges, and parameter tables
Load spec documents from vault files (.json/.yaml/.yml), remote URLs, or fenced code blocks in notes
Scan the vault for OpenAPI files by content and add them as sources
Send requests to endpoints from a debug panel and inspect status, headers, and body
Substitute {{key}} variables in URLs, headers, and bodies with global and per-document scopes
extras: Installation is manual via GitHub releases (download main.js, manifest.json, styles.css), not the community plugin catalog; parts of the usage instructions are written in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view API specifications stored in notes or test their endpoints without leaving the app for an external tool.
summary: Renders OpenAPI/Swagger specs from vault files, URLs, or code blocks as knife4j-style API documentation with built-in request debugging.
